title: John Paul II establishes Vatican observatory for UFO research

tellings.quote: I think it was during his time in the late 80s. The pope signed a decree and a special observatory was established right there inside the Vatican.

plain: In the late 1980s Pope John Paul II is said to have signed a decree setting up a special observatory inside the Vatican to study UFOs. A guest named Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced as the president of a Russian republic, says this, passing it on as something he had heard: "The pope signed a decree and a special observatory was established right there inside the Vatican." If true, it would mean the Catholic Church quietly took UFOs seriously enough to watch for them.
